thesis: GCT is a high-quality, cheap compounder in an intact uptrend, holding its 11/5 earnings gap after a Q3 beat. Revenue grew 27% YoY and net income 36%, at a forward P/E near 10, with low dilution risk. The 11/16 rejection from the 52-week high gives a pullback entry at 62-64 with a defined stop at 57.7 below the gap. The setup is only moderate. Reward/risk is 1.7 and depends on a breakout above 67.40. The risk-off regime (QQQ below its 50- and 200-day averages, VIX at the 0.877 percentile) argues for small sizing and patience on the entry.
